name: ETHFIN
fix_description: Change doBuyback() from public to private. The developer even left a comment "//set to private" but forgot to apply it. As public, anyone can trigger the buyback at a manipulated price to drain BuybackPotBNB.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a multi-step, protocol-specific attack involving holder-count manipulation, a flash loan, several swaps across different Pancake pairs, skim abuse, and triggering a buyback at the right state. It requires understanding the token’s bespoke buyback/holder logic and coordinating multiple contract interactions, but it is still a single-transaction DeFi exploit rather than a deeply complex cross-protocol chain.
